definitions.th: ร้อย (100), ตัวเลข 100

lao_examples.lao_script: ເສື້ອໂລ້ນໂຕນີ້ລາຄາສາມຮ້ອຍກີບ
lao_examples.romanization: suea lon to nii lakhaa saam hoi kiip
lao_examples.translation_en: This T-shirt costs three hundred kip.

lao_examples.lao_script: ຕະຫຼາດນັ້ນຢູ່ໄກປະມານຮ້ອຍແມັດ
lao_examples.romanization: talaat nan yuu glai paman hoi maet
lao_examples.translation_en: That market is about a hundred meters away.
